segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: This morning, in the hearing of the National Irrigation Administration,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: nabanggit natin tatlong malaking hamon ang ating pagtutuunan ng pansin

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: sa mga hearing natin para sa 2027 budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ang patuloy na matinding pagbaha sa Central, Southern, Northern Luzon,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ang mariing napanawagan ng publiko na may managot sa mga ghost at substandard government projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dagdag dito ang krisis na hinaharap ng ating mga magsasaka,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: particular sa usapin ng pagtaas ng presyo ng crudo, ng pataba, ng pesticido,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: at syempre, yung matinding El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya dapat malinaw ang paninindigan ng panukalang 2027 budget ng DAR.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Bawat piso ay dapat may pakinabang, may resulta, at may pananagutan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dapat nitong tiyakin ang karapatan ng mga magsasaka sa lupa,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: palakasin ang mga agrarian reform beneficiaries, at protektahan ang lokal na food production.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Pagpapalakas, sabi nga nila, the worst ever, El Nino.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: The ARS proposed new appropriation of 14.69 billion is 13% lower than its 2026 GAA budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Yet, within that constraint, the proposed budget allocates 5.9 billion for agrarian reform,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: beneficiary development, and sustainability, including P949 million for climate resilient farm productivity support.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Subalit, sapat ba ang mga pondong ito?

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kailangan malinaw kung ano ang aktual na mayahatid ng climate resilient farm productivity support

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: para sa mga agrarian reform beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: At ang resultang inaasahan natin, tunay na pagunlad ng ating mga sakahan,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: mas protektibong, mas matatag, at mas kumikita.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Sa panahon din ng matinding panawagan para sa pananagutan,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: iginigiit din natin na bawat pasilidad, negosyo, at benepisyaryo na suportado ng DAR

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ay madaling ma-verify, ma-geotag, bukas sa publiko ang mga kontrata at impormasyon.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Dumaan din sa independent inspection at napapatunayan aktual at umiiral at gumagana.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Hindi kikilalanin ng climate shocks, ikanga, ang katiwalian, kapababayaan,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: umabagal na burokrasya, hindi rin mapapalitan ng imports,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: ang matatag at matibay at maganda ang output at productivity ng magsasakang Pilipino.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kaya naman ngayon, higit kailanman, kailangan ng tunay na bayanihan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Kailangan sama-samang pagkilos at tapat na pagtutulungan ng gobyerno,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: mga magsasaka, kooperatiba, lokal na pamalaan, at mga mamamayan

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: para maprotektahan natin ang ating mga sakahan.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Nagpapasalamat tayo sa ating schoolmate, Sekretary Conrad Estrella III.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Mas matanda siya ng mga ilang taon lamang, pero palagay ko nakakalamang siya sa paligo sa atin.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We especially like to mention that we are thankful to the Secretary for his full support

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: The Agri-Agra team with Secretary Kiko Laurel.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We have made a lot of progress in terms of interventions to support our farmers and fisher folk.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And I must say, Secretary Conrad has been 101% supportive of our initiatives.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And we are thankful that because of his support, we have been able to put together the Sagip Saka full implementation,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We will now provide for greater support for direct purchases of our farmers and fisher folk.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: And the approval on third reading, at least in the Senate, of Senate Bill 1990 and Senate Bill 1991,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: which is the reestablishment of the Bureau of Agriculture and Fisheries Co-ops under the Department of Agriculture,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: and the renationalization of the extension workers for farmers and fisher folk.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: We hope his support, mabulungan niya ang ating Pangulo,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: para ang House of Representatives, ang ating majority leader,

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Alam nating lahat, pag nasuportahan ang pagkakabuklod-buklod ng mga magsasaka at manging isda

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: sa ilalim ng malakas at matibay na kooperatiba.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: talagang mabibigyan ng ikanga shot in the arm ang ating mga farmers at fisher folk.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: With that, again, we thank you, Sec. Conrad, for championing the cause of our farmers.

segments.speaker: Senator Francis Kiko Pangilinan
segments.text: Mahalagang bagay na ikaw ay isang kasama natin sa Agri-Agra team.
